verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia docs explicitly support the story: pre-request scripts, chaining requests with value extraction/state sharing, environments for variables, and CLI automation for CI (kong-docs-35, kong-docs-38, kong-docs-34, kong-docs-39).
